body.p: Transcriber's Note: The only text in this file is that drawn by the artist as a part of each image. This is not easily read unless you view the "Medium Size" or "Original Size" available by link under each image. The many fine details in each image and the nuances of people's expressions can only be appreciated by clicking on the "Original Size" link. DW
